projects.name: distcc
projects.lead: Listed as: Distributed compiler: ships compile jobs to build servers on the network; CMake uses it via the compiler launcher variable. (claim words: Pump mode with a cpp host suffix further increases compilation speed by also distributing preprocessing to the servers.; licence tag: None; book: CMake Best Practices (2024), ch. 14, section Optimizing build performance, distributed builds with distcc | book: Software Architecture with C++, 2nd ed. (2025), ch. 7, Getting the most out of compilers > Reducing build times > Leveraging tools) Book benchmark: No measurement. Book only describes setup (distccd daemon, DISTCC_HOSTS with cpp and lzo suffixes) and warns that a slow network can cancel the gain.
